summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TCIS Messenger module. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified working. Telegram-style 3-panel layout functioning correctly with private chats, groups, channels, file sharing, reactions, replies, emoji picker, and info panel.
passed_tests: GET /api/chat/contacts - returns 223 contacts with online status
GET /api/chat/list - returns user's chats with unread counts
POST /api/chat/create-channel - creates broadcast channel with only_admins_post=true
POST /api/chat/messages/{id}/forward - forwards messages to other chats
GET /api/chat/{id} - returns chat details with members, pinned, shared files
Reply messages with reply_to_id - creates reply with quoted preview
UI: Chat list shows avatars, names, last message, timestamps, unread badges
UI: Private chat shows blue bubbles (sent) and white bubbles (received)
UI: Group chat shows member count and system messages
UI: Channel shows megaphone icon and only-admins-post restriction
UI: Emoji picker opens with grid of emojis
UI: Chat info panel shows members, files, pinned tabs
UI: New chat menu shows New Chat, New Group, New Channel options
UI: Create Group dialog with name, description, member selection
UI: Contacts tab shows 223 contacts with roles
UI: File attachment card with download button
UI: Reply preview in message bubbles
UI: Different user (Dwain) sees their chats correctly
